## Our mission

The Sequence Analysis Association (SAA) aims to promote research, teaching and diffusion of sequence analysis (SA) and its relationships with related methods. To this end, the SAA

- organises events such as symposia, webinars and training courses,
- collects and shares information on SA-related events, and
- provides links to SA resources — software, books, articles and a shared bibliography.

## History

The SAA was founded during the *International Symposium on Sequence Analysis and Related Methods* (ISSA), held on 10–12 October 2018 at Monte Verità, Ticino, Switzerland. The symposium continued a series of meetings that began with the *Lausanne Conference on Sequence Analysis* (LaCOSA) in 2012 and LaCOSA II in 2016.

![Participants of the 2018 symposium at Monte Verità, where the SAA was founded.](https://sequenceanalysis.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/12/ISSAGroup_s.jpg){fig-alt="Group photo of the participants of the International Symposium on Sequence Analysis 2018 at Monte Verità."}

## Statutes {#statutes}

The SAA is a non-profit association under Swiss law with headquarters in Geneva. Its aims, membership rules and organs — General Assembly, Executive Committee, auditors and Advisory Board — are set out in the statutes.

[[]{.bi .bi-journal-text} Read the statutes](statutes.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}
[[]{.bi .bi-file-earmark-pdf} PDF](saa-statutes.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

## Get involved & contact {#contact}

[]{.bi .bi-person-plus .ico} **Interested in joining?** See [how to become a member](membership.qmd).

You can support the SAA community in several ways:

::: {.icon-list}
- []{.bi .bi-journal-bookmark} **Share publications** on sequence analysis or related methods — we add them to our [Zotero bibliography](https://www.zotero.org/groups/2268769/saa_bibliography/items/).
- []{.bi .bi-code-square} **Tell us about software** — new packages and functions in R, Stata, Python or elsewhere that are useful to SA practitioners.
- []{.bi .bi-people} **Propose an event** — symposia and workshops can be organised with the support of the SAA; send requests to the Executive Committee.
- []{.bi .bi-megaphone} **Announce events** of interest to the community so we can post them on the [blog](blog/index.qmd).
:::
